title: Battle of Nanggulon
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Nanggulon", at revision 1370451282, opens: "The Battle of Nanggulon was an engagement in the Java War between the Dutch colonial forces and rebel forces of Prince Diponegoro, commanded by Sentot Prawirodirdjo, which took place on 28 December 1828. The rebel forces launched an attack on a Dutch detachment close to a newly constructed Dutch fortification, inflicting heavy casualties before being repulsed by another unit." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q133696157, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1828 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
